title: Harness surface
text: Harness surface is not a stored level-row field. Per-machine native listings determine launchable surfaces; Settings shows Launchable on chips. Unsupported listings name the missing adapter and recovery, rather than inventing availability.
evidence: Settings harness chips: QA run 45473 / artifact 32323. Unsupported Claude listing refusal also present in this session launch receipt; other surface mechanics observed in source.
